# Data dictionary — Commercial real estate

**Synthetic demonstration data.** Generated by a monthly discrete-time
hazard process driven by real FRED macroeconomic history. It is not any
institution's portfolio and must never be presented as one.

- Accounts: 45,000
- Account-month rows: 1,793,840
- Window: 2008-01 to 2025-12
- Target: `default_flag` — Nonaccrual or downgrade to a default grade
- EAD method: ccf — Revolving and committed facilities. EAD = drawn + CCF x undrawn. The CCF is estimated from this portfolio with the fixed-horizon 12-month cohort method: take a cohort of non-defaulted facilities and observe the drawdown over the twelve months before default. A regulatory-style fixed CCF is available as a toggle. Term loans in the book carry no undrawn commitment and fall back to the amortizing treatment.

## Panel columns

| Column | Type | Missing | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account_id` | int32 | 0.0% | Account identifier. Unique per account, repeated across performance dates. |
| `performance_date` | datetime64[ns] | 0.0% | Observation month. The panel is one row per account per month. |
| `origination_date` | datetime64[ns] | 0.0% | Month the account was booked. |
| `months_on_book` | int32 | 0.0% | Months elapsed since origination at this performance date. |
| `vintage` | int32 | 0.0% | Origination year. The standard cohort dimension. |
| `original_balance` | float64 | 0.0% | Balance at origination, USD. |
| `current_balance` | float32 | 0.0% | Balance outstanding at this performance date, USD. |
| `scheduled_payment` | float64 | 0.0% | Contractual monthly payment, USD. |
| `interest_rate` | float64 | 0.0% | Note rate, annual decimal (0.089 = 8.9%). |
| `original_term` | int32 | 0.0% | Contractual term at origination, months. |
| `remaining_term` | int32 | 0.0% | Contractual months left at this performance date. |
| `delinquency_bucket` | category | 0.0% | Delinquency status: Current, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180+ DPD. A BEHAVIOURAL variable — exclude it from an origination scorecard, where it is not knowable at the decision point. |
| `status` | object | 0.0% | Current / Delinquent / Defaulted / Paid off / Matured. |
| `terminal_event` | object | 0.0% | none | default | payoff | matured | censored. The account carries no rows after a terminal event. |
| `default_flag` | int8 | 0.0% | TARGET. 1 in the month the default definition is met, else 0. |
| `recovery_amount` | float64 | 0.0% | Cash recovered on a defaulted account, USD. |
| `loss_amount` | float64 | 0.0% | Economic loss on a defaulted account, USD. |
| `exposure_at_default` | float32 | 0.0% | Exposure carried into the default month, USD. Zero otherwise. |
| `drawn_amount` | float32 | 0.0% | Drawn balance on a committed facility, USD. |
| `committed_amount_t` | float32 | 0.0% | Account attribute. |
| `delinquency_state` | int8 | 0.0% | Numeric form of delinquency_bucket (0 = Current). |
| `noi_current` | float32 | 0.0% | Net operating income marked to the property price path, USD. |
| `dscr_reported` | float32 | 0.0% | Debt service coverage ratio AS REPORTED on the tape. Borrower-sourced from annual financials, so it is stale and noisy — a blend of origination underwriting and the current position. |
| `current_ltv` | float32 | 0.0% | Loan to value at this performance date, updated by the actual house price path since origination. |
| `committed_amount` | float64 | 0.0% | Total commitment, USD. |
| `undrawn_amount` | float64 | 0.0% | Commitment less drawn, USD. The CCF applies to this. |
| `utilisation` | float64 | 0.0% | Drawn divided by committed, 0-1. |
| `lgd_realised` | float64 | 0.0% | Realised loss given default, 0-1. Zero for defaults that liquidated whole. |
| `workout_months` | float64 | 0.0% | Months from default to resolution. |
| `watchlist_transfer_flag` | int8 | 0.0% | PLANTED LEAKAGE. Raised when the facility moves to special servicing. Expect IV far above 0.8. |
| `appraiser_panel_code` | int64 | 0.0% | PLANTED NOISE. Expect IV below 0.02. |

## Deliberate imperfections

These are planted so the data-quality and variable-screening steps have
something real to catch. Every one is listed above with a PLANTED note.

- one near-leakage flag with IV far above 0.8
- three pure-noise columns with IV below 0.02
- one correlated pair above 0.95
- one column about 30% missing (MCAR) and one missing-at-random column
- inconsistent categorical coding (the same level spelled several ways)
- outliers, plus one impossible DTI and one negative balance
